servinfo.title: Excessive detonation – Engine continuously generates sharp, metallic knocking sound that changes with throttle opening.
servinfo.ptxt: Perform troubleshooting referring to the following points when ECM has detected no DTC and no abnormality has been found in Visual Inspection:K14C and Engine Basic Inspection:K14C .

condition.ptxt: Excessive detonation – Engine continuously generates sharp, metallic knocking sound that changes with throttle opening.

ps.ptxt: Clogged fuel filter (faulty fuel pump) or fuel lines

action.ptxt: Fuel Pump and Its Circuit Check:K14C or Low-Pressure Fuel Supply Circuit Check:K14C

ps.ptxt: Air drawn in through intake manifold or throttle body gasket
Poor performance of knock sensor, ECT sensor, MAP sensor or MAF sensor

action.ptxt: Knock Sensor On-Vehicle Inspection:K14C , ECT Sensor Inspection:K14C , MAP Sensor Inspection:K14C or MAF Sensor with IAT Sensor-1 Inspection:K14C
Fuel Injector Circuit Check:K14C or Fuel Injector Inspection:K14C

ptxt.intxref: Inspection of ECM and Its Circuits:K14C

action.ptxt: Cylinder, Piston and Piston Ring Inspection:K14C and/or Piston Pin and Connecting Rod Inspection:K14C

item.ptxt: VVT actuator: Camshaft and VVT Actuator Inspection:K14C
Valve timing: Timing Chain and Chain Tensioner Inspection:K14C
OCV oil circuit: Timing Chain Cover Inspection:K14C
